definition: half(q84.1 - q15.9)/median of r = m_est/m_gen, m_gen the generator-level soft-drop mass for resonant and QCD jets alike (ATL-PHYS-PUB-2024-015 Sec. 6); numpy linear quantiles at 0.159 and 0.841

jets.test: mass_resolution.py's test split of the matched jets of classes with >= 50 training jets

groups: resonant: native label < 161; qcd: >= 161; all: both
bins: [lo, hi) GeV; vs_pt in the reconstructed jet pT, vs_mgen in the generator-level soft-drop mass; fewer than 100 jets: null values, the count kept
errors: median_sd, resolution_sd: SD (ddof 1) over 200 jet-level bootstrap resamples, seed 20261102 for every value (equal counts resample identically)
hist: counts of r = m_est/m_gen in [edges[i], edges[i+1]) (last bin closed), on the same test jets as the summaries; underflow / overflow: jets outside the edges

check_against_mass_v3.statistic: sigma68_central: half the central 68% range of ln r (mass_resolution.resolution)
